profile.headline: AI Research & Development @ ByteDance

positions.title: AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Research and prototype cutting-edge AI technologies (LLM & agentic framework) to enhance product capabilities at ByteDance.  
• Educate team members on new technologies via presentation & internal tech blogs, facilitating smoother integration into production.

positions.title: AI Engineer (Forward-Deployed) – Supply Chain
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Built OCR microservices that convert handwritten forms into structured records, improving data quality and unlocking downstream analytics across supply-chain ops.

Deployed and maintained retrieval-augmented LLM assistants inside workflow tools, enabling natural-language queries and faster analysis for non-technical users.

Ran prod infra on NVIDIA NIM + AWS, containerized with Docker and orchestrated via Kubernetes; operated internal databases, models, and MCP servers.

positions.title: Research Asistant, Data & AI System Implementation

company.name: Stanford University Graduate School of Business

positions.title: Project Management Lead
positions.description: As a PM lead, I define project scope, manage expectations with campus partners and clients, and oversee daily workflow, timelines, logistics, and recruitment. I also lead weekly meetings to coordinate efforts and drive progress.

positions.title: Board-level Design Lead
positions.description: As a Board-level Design lead, I guide engineers on my team in creating PCB boards using KiCad and integrate silicon accelerators with client devices.

positions.title: Agentic AI Research
positions.description:
- Developed ways to use AI agent approach (chained LLMs with API calls) to automate the C (HDL) to SystemVerilog (RTL) design process 
- Presented results at an academic conference via research poster

positions.title: Satellite Avionics Engineer
positions.description: I contributed to the satellite's magnetorquer and solar-panel power board design in XY direction using KiCad. I also assembled and debugged PCB boards after manufacturing.

positions.title: Columnist
positions.description: Enhanced non-fiction writing skills through participation in workshops and seminars, coupled with in-depth research into various assigned topics.

positions.title: Stanford Psych-Summer Research Program
positions.description: Analyzed behavioral data of 15 subjects using Python, identifying key trends, and ensured protocol compliance in data collection from diverse subjects. Contributed to subject recruitment, clearly presented research findings, and collaborated with a 20+ member lab team.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Managed research subject interviews and data collection, coordinated with subjects and parents for scheduling, and assisted in recruitment. Handled data management and reporting, and conducted cognitive and MRI screening tasks.

positions.title: SLE 99 Directed Reading Leader
positions.description: Led two college reading groups on 'The Great Gatsby' and 'One Hundred Years of Solitude,' teaching 12 undergraduates per group and fostering a dynamic discussion environment. Coordinated with university staff for space and service reservations.
